name: anton-memory-lifecycle-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Anton. Restore its documented conversation-turn behavior across dispatch, LLM and tool execution, event observation, lesson formation, memory recall, and scratchpad outcomes. The governing contracts are the repository and package READMEs; the developer guides on architecture, dispatch, tools, memory, ACC, scratchpad runtime, skills, and trace headers; the connected web-tool guides; the teaching guides on episodes, lessons, and recall; the user guides on chats and sessions; and public docstrings in the corresponding `anton/core` modules. Read those contracts together with the code before changing behavior.

Keep public APIs and existing turn, tool, and memory integrations working. The documented event and result paths must agree with the implementation from a turn's execution through the memory and scratchpad state it leaves behind.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
